pages.title: Cleansing Methods
pages.text: The $(curse)cursed earth$() can be cleansed through several methods. The most accessible is creating a $(item)salt circle$() and using a $(item)Purification Staff$().$(br2)For larger areas, construct a $(gold)Solar Spire$() to channel $(deity)Ra's$() light.

pages.title: Salt
pages.text: Pure salt crystals used to create protective circles. Place salt dust on the ground in a circle pattern to form a ritual boundary.

pages.title: Purification Staff
pages.text: Channels divine energy to cleanse cursed earth. Stand within a salt circle and hold right-click for 3 seconds to purify up to 8 blocks.

pages.title: Solar Spire
pages.text: The $(gold)Solar Spire$() is a multi-block structure that cleanses large areas when activated. Build the plinth, crucible, and pyramidion in sequence.$(br2)See the $(l:blocks/solar_spire)Solar Spire entry$(/l) for details.
